# DNS v2

<!-- Generated by sdkgen; edit internal/cmd/sdkgen/service_docs.go. -->

Use Gophercloud v2.15.0's dns/v2 API through one authenticated service object. Connection manages authentication, region, endpoint interface and TLS.

Service access: `conn.DNSV2(ctx)` (openstacksdk: `conn.dns`).

`FindIdentity` on the scope returned by `RecordSets.InZone(ctx, parent)` resolves name/ID strings automatically, with list fallback after GET400/403/404, exact ID/name and duplicate checks, and a default missing result of `nil, nil`. Select strict handling with `resource.WithIdentityFindIgnoreMissing(false)`. Caller `WithIdentityFindQuery` filters survive GET and fallback listing; automatic name hints apply only to listing. Concrete options control query/fallback. See [identity finding](../../docs/finding-identities.md) for binding, fixed parents, domain filters and path policy.

`conn.DNSProjectQuotas(ctx, project)` and `CurrentDNSProjectQuotas(ctx)` fix the Designate quota project. [Quotas](quotas/README.md) covers Get/PATCH Update/DELETE Reset and sudo-project/all-projects headers. There is no separate defaults endpoint or project quota list.

## Go usage

```go
// Inside a function with context.Context ctx and *openstack.Connection conn.
service, err := conn.DNSV2(ctx)
if err != nil { return err }
for value, err := range service.Zones.Resources.List(ctx) {
    if err != nil { return err }
    fmt.Println(value)
}
value, err := service.Zones.Find(ctx, resource.Name("example"))
if err != nil { return err }
_ = value
```

Examples use `fmt` and `github.com/JSYoo5B/go-openstacksdk/resource`.
